Create one square illustration contact sheet, precisely 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, exactly 16 separate illustrations. No text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos, borders or visible grid lines. Each subject wholly inside its own cell, centered with generous safety margins; no subject crosses cells. Follow the listed subjects exactly in row-major reading order: left to right, then top to bottom. Keep each cell visually independent.

Row 2, column 4: A curved paved road through gentle green countryside.
Row 3, column 1: One honeybee with six legs, striped fuzzy abdomen and translucent wings beside a flower.
Row 3, column 2: A pair of fluffy blue winter earmuffs with a headband.
Row 3, column 3: A pink segmented earthworm on garden soil, no legs.
Row 3, column 4: A brown owl with conspicuous ear-tuft feathers perched on a branch.
Row 4, column 1: A clear glass of white milk beside an unlabelled glass milk bottle.
Row 4, column 2: Several round cooked meatballs in tomato sauce on a plate.
Row 4, column 3: Three golden wheat stalks with ripe grain heads.
Row 4, column 4: A woven straw sun hat with a simple blue ribbon.

parentProcessing: 登録CSVのsourceSheetとtileIndexを既存規約へ統一。境界ずれのある8シートは原本を維持し実境界に従って再抽出。
parentReview: 親担当が最終の256px画像64枚の一覧を目視確認。具体的な欠け・隣コマ混入を修正し、ゲーム内PC/スマホ表示も全64枚合格。
